text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"The patient reported symptoms lasting 'a few weeks now', not a week."},{"i":1,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":27,"why":"The patient explicitly denied any other symptoms."},{"i":2,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":37,"why":"The patient explicitly denied ear pain, discharge, fever, and itchiness."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":35,"why":"The patient confirmed the numbness and hearing difficulty are present now."},{"i":4,"v":"INFERRED","u":51,"why":"The patient mentioned 'labyrinthitis' and 'nose polyps' in the past."},{"i":5,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":54,"why":"The patient mentioned using Rennies and a nasal spray for the nose."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":62,"why":"The patient mentioned a latex allergy."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":87,"why":"The doctor suggested Bell's Palsy and the need for a neurological examination."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":98,"why":"The doctor explicitly stated the plan for a face-to-face review."},{"i":9,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":107,"why":"The patient confirmed understanding and agreement with the plan."}]}
